{{Quote|Surely you've followed events at Glova, Glom Tho and Druckenwell? The Empire no longer exists, and its warlords are in retreat throughout the Trailing Sectors.|[[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], to [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Quarsh Panaka/Legends|Quarsh Panaka]]|<ref name="Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut">{{SW|url=news/the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-part-6-showdown-at-naboo|series=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|text=Part 6: Showdown at Naboo}}</ref>}}
A '''battle''' at the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Druckenwell/Legends|Druckenwell]] was an engagements between the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].<ref name="TEA" />

After the end of the [[Nagai–Tof War]], the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] launched its main liberation campaign against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]]. Coming from [[Bothan Space/Legends|Bothan Space]], the [[New Republic Fourth Fleet]] attacked and captured [[Druckenwell/Legends|Druckenwell]].<ref name="Warfare" />
